verdict.rationale: Datadog's integrations page says it can track code changes and deployments alongside application performance via GitHub and GitLab integrations, which supports deploy-to-performance correlation. That is a single marketing-level line, and nothing documents configuration-change tracking or how regressions are tied to specific releases. Missing for 10: dedicated deployment/release tracking docs, configuration-change tracking, an explicit workflow for attributing a regression to a release, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking

citations.quote: Track code changes, deployments, and application performance in real time with integrations across software delivery platforms like GitLab and GitHub.
